subject: SummitCyber: SIG/CAIQ Q&A and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@summitcyber.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@summitcyber.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG/CAIQ kickoff + doc handoff

Hi Rafael —

Thanks again for taking the time. Summit Cyber is starting a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our vendor intake and we want to kick off with a short Q&A to align scope and owners. Primary asks on our side:
- Walk through how Redwood handles data in hosted vs. dedicated deployments (KV cache retention, logs).
- Confirm SOC 2 controls mapping and where evidence lives.
- Quick tour of the CAIQ responses so we know which artifacts you can share.

Can we schedule a 45-min call this week? Our security team (security@summitcyber.com) would like to join, and procurement may join to confirm timelines. I've attached an initial questionnaire export (we'll send the full SIG separately).

Thanks,
Liam
Lead Security Engineer
Summit Cyber

[Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.csv (CSV, 1 page)]

From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@summitcyber.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@summitcyber.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ kickoff + doc handoff

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the note. Happy to run a 45-min Q&A. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 12/01 10:00–10:45
- Tue 12/01 15:00–15:45
- Wed 12/02 09:00–09:45

I'll bring Soojin from our security & compliance team to cover SOC 2/CAIQ mappings and Marissa from Trust Ops for artifacts. For the agenda I suggest: 1) scope & deployment modes, 2) SOC 2/CAIQ walk-through, 3) evidence handoff timeline, 4) open Q&A and next steps.

Pre-call: I'll upload a draft SIG/CAIQ response matrix and a network diagram for context. If you can share the full SIG export before the call that would speed things up.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

[Attachment: redwood-sig-draft-v0.9.xlsx (XLSX, 12 sheets)]

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ kickoff + doc handoff — evidence owners & gaps

Thanks Rafael. Quick note on owners and what's realistic to hand off before your internal review:

Owners (Redwood):
- SOC 2 control narratives & evidence: Marissa Cole (Trust Ops)
- Network diagram & infra context: Infra Ops (I attached a lightweight diagram)
- Data retention & KV cache behavior: Soojin Lee (Security)
- Logging & audit exports: Soojin Lee / Eng Ops (we can provide samples)

Pre-call deliverables we'll try to share by EOD Mon: a) draft CAIQ response matrix (spreadsheet), b) high-level network-diagram.pdf, c) pointer to SOC 2 evidence index (redacted). After our internal review some items will require an NDA or MSA amendment for production log extracts — we can flag those during the call.

Agenda tweak: put the MSA/NDA/evidence gating discussion after the technical Q&A so procurement can join that part.

Soojin
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
